name: credit_spread
concept: Canadian broad-market corporate credit spread over comparable Government of Canada debt
transformation: Direct spread level in percentage points; do not substitute a bank lending rate or generic financial-conditions index
notes: Bank of Canada research defines corporate spreads as corporate yields less comparable Government of Canada yields and uses broad-market spread series for macro analysis. The canonical historical series cited by Bank research relies on market data not reproducible from the repository alone, so historical fixtures must retain the model default until an open equivalent is selected and validated.

name: housing_gap
concept: Housing affordability pressure relative to a one-sided historical benchmark
transformation: 100 * (HAI_t / median(HAI_{t-20}...HAI_{t-1}) - 1), using the latest HAI quarter available by the historical decision cutoff; HAI_t is excluded from the 20-quarter benchmark and no later quarter may enter it
notes: The Bank of Canada Housing Affordability Index measures representative housing-related carrying costs as a share of disposable income. V2 converts that level to a signed pressure gap against the prior 20-quarter median. data/calibration/housing_affordability_benchmarks.csv records the selected quarter, conservative source-update cutoff and benchmark median for each shipped fixture. Public historical HAI levels can be revised, so this reconstruction is information-window clean but is not claimed to be a frozen archival real-time data vintage.
